This template is intended to be used to list out-of-universe people, locations, and organizations that are mentioned in a given source. It is not intended as a replacement for [[Template:Credits]] and should not be used to cover individuals or companies solely being credited for a piece of media, only those mentioned in the content of the media itself.

This template is not yet in widespread usage, and it's rollout is was discussed here: [[Forum:SH:OOU Appearances Lists]]

"|people" should be used to note real individuals noted in the source, arranged in alphabetical order by surname<br />
"|locations" should be used to note real locations noted in the source, arranged in alphabetical order<br />
"|organizations" should be used to note real organizations and companies noted in the source, arranged in alphabetical order<br />
"|media" should be used to note other media noted in the source, arranged by release date and using templates where possible<br />
"|miscellanea" should be used to note miscellanoues articles noted in the source, arranged in alphabetical order

To place the template on a page, copy the following code:
<pre>{{OOUappearances
|people=
|locations=
|organizations=
|media=
|miscellanea=
}}</pre>

This should produce the following table:
{{OOUappearances
|people=*[[George Lucas]]
*[[Stewart McKenny]]
*[[Genndy Tartakovsky]]
|locations=*[[Fox Studios, Sydney]]
*[[Skywalker Ranch]]
*[[Tunisia]]
|organizations=*[[501st Legion (fan organization)|501st Legion]]
*[[Mandalorian Mercs]]
*[[StarWars.com]]
|media=
*{{CW|2}}
*{{Shortstory|story=The Tale of the Aiwha Pod (short story)|sformatted=The Tale of the Aiwha Pod|book=Star Wars: Republic Commando: Prima Official Game Guide}}
*{{Film|VII}}
|miscellanea=
*[[Jedi Engine]]
}}
